data.title: Visions of the Unwritten - Act IV: The Balance of Fractions

objective1.description: Receive emergency notice regarding Sati's sanctuary
objective1.dial: The Frenchman believes Sati holds the master code to the skybox. His Exiles are closing in on Park East. Protect her.

objective2.description: Meet Sati at the Park East Secluded Bench
objective2.dial: I made this sunrise for the Oracle, and for you. Look at the colors! But bad men are coming through the trees...

objective3.dial: The child belongs to the Château! Hand her over and the Merovingian will spare your RSI.

objective4.dial: Cause and effect! You stand in our way, so you get deleted!

objective5.description: Ensure Sati's sunrise routine completes uninterrupted
objective5.dial: The sun came up anyway. See? The light is stronger than their guns. Thank you, redpill.

objective6.description: Report the sanctuary defense back to the Oracle
objective6.dial: As long as that little girl can paint the sunrise, there is still hope for tomorrow. But the real storm is gathering.
